title: Compose Rs New Architecture
description: Rebuild compose/rs/lib.rs as a clean greenfield skeleton matching compose/graphql/target.schema.graphql: one struct per GraphQL type with a main impl + an #[Object] impl, all pub fn async, a single global emit_event, and a parent/child web-worker topology where the parent routes Query.wip and Query.authoritative to two child workers. Wire one end-to-end operation (CreatedFixedPiece) through the full path as the reference flow.
summary: Refactored compose/rs to in-memory Arc references with no value cloning. Every entity (Connector, Representation, Type, Side, Connection, Piece, Design, Kit, Change, Transaction, Draft, Checkpoint, Alternative, Graph, Session, Conflict, all Op*) is now constructed once as Arc<Self>; every mutable field lives behind async_lock::RwLock<FieldT>; owned children switched to RwLock<Vec<Arc<T>>>; back-references switched to Weak<Parent>. Constructors return Arc<Self>; all mutators take &self via interior write-locks. All #[Object] resolvers return Arc<Child> / Option<Arc<Child>> / Vec<Arc<Child>> for relationships and deref a single per-field read-guard for value leaves; owners upgrade Weak. ParentRuntime now holds Arc<Graph> directly (snapshot helpers deleted); Query.wip / Query.authoritative return Arc<Graph>. Operation structs carry Arc<Entity> payloads; KitEvent variants wrap Arc<Op>; OperationKind / OperationIface unions / interface dispatch over Arc<*> variants. Single emit_event preserved (guard test still pins the canonical signature). Fixed an unrelated EventBus dead-lock by setting set_await_active(false) on the broadcast Sender so emits no longer block when there are no active subscribers. Added two new tests: no_deep_clone_on_traversal (Arc::strong_count guard around a deep GraphQL query) and mutation_visible_without_resnapshotting (two reads across a mutation prove in-place mutability). cargo check passes for both native and wasm32-unknown-unknown; cargo test --lib passes with all 6 tests green.
